findings.finding: V10 reported 84 green rule tests but eliminated no spatial alternative, so the compiler could not falsify its own proposal.
findings.remediation: Generate three same-task S7 geometries and apply identical route, access, fire, retirement, staff and unknown-integrity gates.
findings.verification: The deterministic audit yields one reject_design, one revise_design and exactly one advance_design; the build fails if that diversity disappears.

findings.finding: The strongest V10 structured evidence was not visible in the first scoring surfaces.
findings.remediation: Put ALT-A/B/C, the failed gates and selected geometry into metrics-evidence, A0-02, A3 page 1 and both HTML first screens.
findings.verification: Canonical entry surfaces state who is rejected, why, and which design advances while preserving field-unknown disclosure.

findings.finding: Earlier A3 station pages repeated a shared comparison figure and A0-03 contained low-information areas.
findings.remediation: Give T2 and S2 distinct detailed plans and fill A0-03 with audit, permits, RACI, 90-day delivery and field-unknown panels.
findings.verification: Final bilingual publications preserve 3/3/16/16 pages, distinct station archetypes and no empty placeholder panel.

findings.finding: V3–V10 scripts, screenshots and styles remained inside the active package and obscured the canonical V11 build path.
findings.remediation: Remove assets with no V11 consumer and retain one audit/content/publication/HTML/QA chain; Git history remains the recovery mechanism.
findings.verification: Dependency scan finds no active reference to removed scripts or review-v10 assets; manifest is regenerated from existing files.

findings.finding: Official survey, ownership, station entrances, statutory controls, utilities and observed flows remain unavailable.
findings.remediation: Keep every dimension and boundary provisional and rerun the audit when formal data arrives.

findings.finding: No scene has been field-run; safety, traffic, satisfaction, cost and recovery time remain unknown.
findings.remediation: Do not issue adopt/revise/stop until baseline and controlled field evidence exist.

findings.finding: Public OSM context is incomplete around the prototype.
findings.remediation: Show low-confidence context and verify building edges professionally before E2 implementation.

findings.finding: Automated in-app browser control rejects file:// navigation.
findings.remediation: Use static offline dependency QA and leave runtime visual review to the user; do not claim an automated browser pass.
